final: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS size_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(size_per_ms) AS avg_size_per_ms FROM album_stats) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_price, a.size_per_ms, a.size_per_ms - o.avg_size_per_ms FROM album_stats AS a JOIN overall AS o ON o.avg_size_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.size_per_ms - o.avg_size_per_ms DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
